description: Deterministic release-gate contract for the PetTripFinder Indianapolis market through PTF-INDIANAPOLIS-PROMOTION-AND-APPLICATION-004. Calibrated to THIS market's assembled package.

deployment_authorization.means: A passing contract means this market's assembled package is STRUCTURALLY deployable. It is NOT a deployment authorization. Indianapolis stands at 264 identities and 82 published profiles in SOURCE; one identity is withheld under a named founder hold (IDH-024) pending an authorized rekey. 138 of 264 identities remain unresolved.

identity_census.note: The committed census is the promoted Indianapolis identity universe. PTF-INDIANAPOLIS-PROMOTION-AND-APPLICATION-004 admitted Tru by Hilton Indianapolis Lawrence (Hilton code inddlru) and renamed the La Quinta Lynhurst row to its Baymont successor at the same premises under founder precedent IDR-007-001, taking 263 -> 264.

reconciliation.note: PTF-INDIANAPOLIS-PROMOTION-REMEDIATION-005 withheld one identity from the promotion by founder ruling -- its normalized key is claimed by a different Cleveland hotel and order 017 had already refused it. Indianapolis stands at 264 census, 82 pet-friendly, 44 verified no-pets.

policy_package.note: The Indianapolis policy package is the sole identity authority for its 83 verified pet-friendly profiles.
policy_package.schema_note: Schema 1.3; each record carries its founder decision binding, its withholdings with their sentences and its evidence references.

public_surface.held_hotel_exclusion: The five founder HOLDs of PTF-INDIANAPOLIS-FOUNDER-REVIEW-002 were resolved in PREP-003; every unresolved census identity (deferred, alternate-lane, no official URL, brand-excluded, identity-mismatched or policy-not-found) has no seed row and no public route.

routes.note: Routes are derived from the 83 published records and the committed Indianapolis corridor assignment; unresolved identities are absent.

publish.note: The publish root must contain ONLY the static website plus the two Netlify control files. Build-internal reports the generator emits (_build_report.json, _broken_link_report.json, _quality_report.json, bundle_manifest.json) are read for gating but are excluded from site/ and must never ship.
